info.title: PROMOFY API
info.description: Versioned REST API. Admin endpoints use Sanctum SPA cookie auth (CSRF via /sanctum/csrf-cookie) and server-side permission checks. Guest cart/order access uses X-Cart-Token / X-Order-Token headers. Money is decimal strings in the order/payment currency; no implicit FX.
